This radiant, acrylic tray is handmade in Texas and is the perfect conversation piece. Corral the remotes on your coffee table, or take cocktails out to the patio this piece is as functional as it is gorgeous. 

Beauty like a rose, strength like a weed. This gorgeous acrylic tray features the image of Angela Fabbri's painting of a flower bouquet. The inversion message reads "BLOOM BIG."

Measurements: 14" x 14" x 2" 
*WIPE WITH DAMP CLOTH ONLY. DO NOT PUT IN DISHWASHER. DIRECT CONTACT WITH WATER MAY DAMAGE THE IMAGE.
